cohort: The participants were 389 IVF dichorionic twin pregnancies with a gestational age of >=23 weeks, occurring between 2010 and 2022.
finding: Twin pregnancies conceived via fresh embryo transfer resulted in significantly worse obstetrical and neonatal outcomes, including earlier gestational age, lower birthweight, and higher rates of preterm birth and NICU admissions, compared to those conceived via frozen-thawed embryo transfer.
